title: PAM account-property change planning
archiveStatus: Offline planner + unverified, guarded live executor
entryPoint: python -m labkit pam-plan examples/pam-accounts.json local-output/pam-plan.json --suffix example.invalid --port 9443
requiredValidation: One patch remains a JSON array rather than collapsing into an object.
Other properties survive the operation and duplicate port casing is rejected.
A failed update stops the batch; earlier successful operations are not described as rolled back.
